source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES treats PSU1~6 as one literal sensor and truncates fallback inventory; it omits six fitted/empty bay identities, mixed-model PMBus fields, load-share/redundancy context and complete UI/spec evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION requires separate records, an installed-slot matrix, model-specific rules and no PSU manipulation.

old_problem: One literal range query or a sensor count could be claimed as six-bay coverage without binding each fitted module to bay, serial/model/capacity/feed and exact PMBus field or explicitly dispositioning empty bays. Mixed models, standby/load-share and degraded redundancy could be misjudged, and CRPS1/2 could be incorrectly substituted.
disposition_reason: Build an authoritative six-bay fitted/empty matrix distinct from CRPS1/2. Resolve every defined PSU record separately, bind fitted bays to immutable module identity, AC feed, current state and the model-specific PMBus page/object/temperature field, then compare complete OOB/two-UI evidence with the correct field/state limits under unchanged power and cooling conditions.
decision_basis: XLSX row 894, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, internal Script reference, selection manifest, adjacent/related source cases and historical record were directly reviewed.
Tilde shorthand is not proven IPMI syntax; all six bays require explicit fitted, empty or unavailable outcomes rather than a count or sample.
Mixed PSU models can expose different PMBus channels and limits, so bay/serial/model/page/object plus load-share state are necessary.
ED-03 forbids guessed OEM parameters, ED-13 governs empty/standby N/A, ED-15 requires model/field/state limits, ED-17 preserves logs and ED-20 separates all bays and CRPS coverage.

test_case.test_name: Verify PSU1 through PSU6 temperatures as a complete fitted/empty bay and model-specific PMBus matrix
test_case.purpose: Verify all six defined PSU bays have an approved fitted/empty/unavailable outcome and every fitted module's temperature is separately human readable in Dashboard and Server Health, maps to the correct bay/module and exact PMBus field, and meets applicable value, units, health, threshold/hysteresis and freshness requirements for its current state.
required_package: Chassis/power-subsystem PN/revision, BMC build and authoritative six-bay definition distinct from CRPS1/2
Per-bay AC feed, PN/serial/HW/FW/capacity, fitted/empty and active/standby/load-share state
Vendor PMBus reference for every fitted model with controller/bus/mux/address/page/command and exact inlet/internal/outlet field
Separate stable SDR/API and Dashboard/Server Health identities for PSU1 through PSU6
Per-model/field units/scaling, approved range/delta, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health, polling/freshness and unavailable rules
Acceptance for empty bays, mixed models, capacity mismatch, degraded redundancy and asymmetric load sharing
Recorded system power, per-module input/output/current/load, fan speeds, ambient and airflow
Validated protected read-only BMC/PMBus/API/browser clients and pinned immutable reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual method
test_case.test_command: Do not clear SEL/kernel/PSU black-box/PMBus history, hot-remove/reseat modules, disconnect feeds, change load/redundancy/load-share/fans/thresholds or issue PMBus writes. Build a six-row bay/population/serial/model/feed/state/PMBus-field matrix from approved inventory and vendor specs. Enumerate the complete BMC repository and resolve PSU1 through PSU6 separately; do not use `TEMP_PSU1~6` as one record unless explicitly documented. Review the Script before use. Capture every row's independent query status, identity or defined absence, exact field, value, units, capability/threshold/hysteresis, health and timestamp plus matching Dashboard and Server Health evidence. Compare fitted rows with model/field/state limits. Stop without retry on unexpected population, swapped, stale or divergent rows.
test_case.expected_result: All six rows have an approved fitted/empty/unavailable outcome. Every fitted record and both UI rows map to the correct bay, serial/model/feed and vendor-defined PMBus field and independently match model/field/current-state value/unit/threshold/status/freshness rules. CRPS telemetry, aggregate health, one PSU or a partial count never substitutes and power state is unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires six explicit outcomes, fitted-module identity/PMBus semantics and separate complete OOB/two-UI/spec agreement for every applicable bay with engineer verdict. One literal range query, sample/count, CRPS data, generic limit, label-only match or truncated output cannot pass. Missing/swapped/stale identity, unjustified empty/N/A, wrong model field, out-of-limit value or required threshold/status/UI mismatch is FAIL. Missing vendor maps/state rules/reviewed method is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS; hot-swap, redundancy, efficiency, AC loss and threshold events are outside scope.
safety_gate: Do not clear SEL, kernel, PSU black-box or PMBus history; power/thermal evidence must remain intact.
Do not interpret the range as one record; explicitly disposition all six bays and keep CRPS1/2 separate.
Do not assume identical models, fields or limits and do not guess OEM PMBus parameters.
Do not hot-swap/reseat modules, disconnect feeds, change load/redundancy/load-share/fans/thresholds or write PMBus.
Apply model, population, state and capability rules; empty or standby behavior is valid only when documented.
Do not truncate output, expose credentials or run an unreviewed Script; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Chassis/power-subsystem PN/revision, BMC and authoritative six-bay matrix with per-bay feed/PN/serial/HW/FW/capacity/state
Per-model PMBus references plus controller/bus/mux/address/page/command and temperature-field map
Complete separate raw evidence for all bays with stable IDs, values or defined unavailable state, units, thresholds, health and timestamps plus UI rows
Recorded system/per-module power, load-share/redundancy, fan/ambient/airflow and model/field/state comparisons
Missing/swapped/mixed-model/empty/degraded/stale/divergent disposition and pinned Script or alternate-method audit
No-clear/no-hot-swap/no-feed-or-load-change/no-PMBus-write/no-retry proof, final PSU/BMC health and six-bay engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected. On population, bay, model, state or PMBus-field ambiguity, stale/divergent values or unexpected PSU/BMC health change, stop and preserve all first-pass evidence plus inventory/feed/load-share state. Obtain the correct vendor reference and use approved read-only diagnostics; do not alter hardware or power to force evidence. Any independently authorized power action requires its own recovery plan.
